goal: Make SolQvia real-device testing repeatable and directly consumable by the Phase161 diagnosis engine without adding inference during capture or projection.
capture_order: B SIM/eSIM recognition and eSIM lifecycle
official_basis: Android PhysicalChannelConfig for band/network type/primary-secondary/bandwidth observations
Android PreciseDataConnectionState for data connection/APN/link/failure state
Android IMS RegistrationManager callbacks for explicit IMS registration state
Apple Settings > General > About for software version, modem firmware, carrier information and visible IMS status
Apple carrier settings guidance for carrier settings version and SIM/eSIM-related updates
privacy_rules: No serial number, IMEI/IMEI2, MEID, EID, ICCID, IMSI, MSISDN or phone number is retained.
No activation code, confirmation code, account credentials, PIN/PUK or APN credentials are retained.
Screenshots/API outputs containing identifiers must be redacted before retention.
Only coarse test-location scope is stored.
safety_and_evidence_rules: Routine capture never requires a real emergency call.
Routine capture does not delete/reissue eSIM or factory/network reset the device.
Routine capture does not change hidden/service-menu radio settings solely to force a result.
Capture-to-Phase161 projection is structural only and performs no semantic inference.
Generic data/voice/SMS success never backfills hidden registration/IMS/APN/CA states.
next_phase: Phase163 integrate Capture/Diagnosis evidence summaries into Device Passport with three-tier UX: answer first, troubleshooting actions, technical/evidence detail.
